messages:
alex_support: @lina_billing customer ACME (invoice 2026-01-AC-123) says invoice shows ~18k extra embedding units vs dashboard. They used the rerank/pairwise API with batch_size=64 and some async retries. Can we triage?

lina_billing: What's the invoice delta vs dashboard? raw numbers pls + any request_ids they shared. dashboard shows per-route usage (monthly) so good to know if it's concentrated in a small window.

alex_support: Dashboard shows 22,800 embed units for Jan, invoice lists 41,200 units. Customer provided one request_id: req_0a1b2c3d. Says they run pairwise rerank via /v1/rerank with pairwise=true, candidates array of ~300 items, query list of ~10. They had a few 429 retries in the window.

raj_engineer: tagging in case this looks like the pairwise accounting edge we patched last quarter. Quick checks: 1) did we change dedupe cache normalization recently? 2) are retries counted idempotently? 3) is meter service summing pre-dedupe counts but billing UI shows post-dedupe?

ops-bot: meter.log excerpt for req_0a1b2c3d -> [2026-01-17T14:12:03Z] model=rwd-emb-1024 pairwise_request=true inputs=310 candidates=300 queries=10 counted_vectors=620 meter_event_id=me_9f8e

lina_billing: invoice aggregates from billing ledger show ledger_row: lr_7781 -> billed_vectors=1240 for that job window. That's double what dashboard's unique vector count shows (620).

sara_cs: customer says they see ~620 in the dashboard (they screenshot), but invoice is ~1240. They insist they didn't submit duplicates.

raj_engineer: Hypothesis: when pairwise=true we internally expand to two embedding batches (candidates + queries). We dedupe candidates across the batch and use a cache to avoid extra model calls; the dashboard metric uses the deduped count from the runtime, but the billing pipeline currently sums the pre-deduped enqueue events (i.e., before cache dedupe). That would double-count when dedupe happens. Also retries could cause additional enqueue events.

alex_support: Can you reproduce locally? If so we can produce a minimal repro to show meter vs ledger divergence.

raj_engineer: Quick repro steps below. Minimal curl to simulate pairwise + intentional whitespace variance to stress dedupe normalization:

```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.inference/v1/rerank \ 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" -H "Content-Type: application/json" \ 
  -d '{
    "model": "rwd-rerank-1",
    "pairwise": true,
    "queries": ["Find foo"],
    "candidates": ["Item A","Item A ","Item B","Item C"],
    "batch_size": 64
  }'
```

raj_engineer: In local dev meter.log: counted_vectors=8 (pre-dedupe), runtime_deduped=4. Billing emulator (ledger) currently summarizes enqueue events and returns billed=8. Dashboard (telemetry) reports 4. That matches the customer's delta.

lina_billing: OK that explains the 2x. Are retries making it worse? If an async retry re-enqueues the same pre-dedupe events we could see >2x.

ops-bot: audit.log shows three retry events for req_0a1b2c3d between 14:12:03 and 14:12:17. Metering shows additional enqueue traces for each retry (me_9f8e, me_9f8f, me_9f90).

raj_engineer: Root cause summary: billing pipeline consumes raw enqueue events (pre-cache/dedupe) and doesn't apply the runtime dedupe logic; dashboard/telemetry reads post-dedupe counts. Combined with retries, ledger billed more vectors than dashboard reported.

alex_support: Proposed mitigation: 1) short-term: issue credit to ACME for the delta and flag invoice 2026-01-AC-123 for manual adjustment (billing ticket BT-4521). 2) mid-term: change billing aggregation to dedupe by the same normalization key we use at runtime (content-hash after trimming/normalization) OR move dedupe decision earlier. 3) add metrics to detect divergence (ledger_vs_runtime ratio > 1.25).

lina_billing: I created BT-4521 and queued refund for the delta pending ops confirmation. Also adding acceptance criteria for the mid-term fix.

raj_engineer: I'll open an infra issue (INF-3347) to align the billing aggregator with runtime dedupe key. Quick patch idea: when emitting enqueue events include dedupe_key and a boolean "cache_hit" so the billing pipeline can collapse duplicates by dedupe_key within a job window.

sara_cs: Customer is fine with a credit if we explain the cause. Please cc me on the billing PR so I can update them.

alex_support: cc @sara_cs. Thanks everyone — labelling this thread for postmortem and followup. Will update ACME once BT-4521 is processed.
